purpose: Create high-precision structured review candidates from pre-anchor pages while rejecting generic marketing and context-free keyword hits.

committed_capacity_expansion: adding/increasing/expanding installed capacity with company attribution
multi_phase_growth_roadmap: phase II/2 or phase III/3 + plant/facility/expansion/project context
funding_visibility: completed fund raise specifically linked to expansion/capex
physical_or_operational_headroom: expandable/modular installed capacity or explicit physical headroom

qualification_or_regulatory_barrier: approved vendor/vendor approval/qualified by named or customer-class evidence
regulatory approval specifically required for the product/market
cost_process_or_scale_advantage: specific cost/process/yield/scale advantage rather than generic efficiency
market_position_or_limited_competition: market leader/market leadership with product/segment context
sole supplier/single source/only manufacturer/limited qualified competition

new_geography: enter/entered/entry into a specific new market/geography
new geographic market/distribution expansion with action/status
adjacent_vertical_or_use_case: new/adjacent vertical, segment or use case + product/capability deployment

explicit_low_confidence_rejections: leading company/leading player without market-position evidence
approval/qualification mentioned only as a generic process
export percentage or existing export mix without expansion action
new product mentioned only as a category heading without launch/development/commercial action
market/industry capacity expansion rather than company capacity
review_policy: A model/human reviewer may mark APPROVED only when the structured relation passes all guards and the category meaning is unambiguous. Otherwise REJECTED or PENDING. No return information may be available during review.
